description: Edit a listing you registered, using the owner key issued when it was published. Send id, owner_key and only the fields to change. With a verified proof the edit publishes at once; changing endpoint, auth or docsUrl re-runs the live check first and refuses the edit if it fails, and an endpoint moved to a host the proof does not cover is queued for review. The id is fixed, listings cannot be hidden or deleted this way, and the response omits the key. Same path and limits as PATCH /api/v1/mcp-directory/servers/{id}; no durable receipt.

auth.description: How callers sign in; a change re-runs the live check

companyUrl.description: Https company website; an empty string clears it

docsUrl.description: Your documentation page for this server; a change re-runs the live check

endpoint.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint (https); a change re-runs the live check

id.description: The listing id returned at registration

note.description: Optional note for reviewers when the edit is queued

owner_key.description: The owner key issued when the listing was published; verified for this listing and omitted from the response

requirements.description: Up to 4 prerequisites a user must already have (e.g. a vendor account or paid subscription), beyond endpoint sign-in

tools.description: Replaced by the live tool list when the check passes

name: koskamo_update_mcp_server
title: Update an MCP server listing
